shadows.purpose: A restrained lift beneath the hero specimen avatars.

motion.name: specimen-hover
motion.purpose: A small upward movement on an interactive specimen.

components.name: Tile Mosaic Avatar
components.description: A full-square geometric repeat in bold color, built from edge-matched tile cells.
components.css: .ds-avatar-frame { display: inline-block; overflow: hidden; padding: 2px; border: 1.5px solid #20242a; border-radius: 3px; background: #f5f2e9; } .ds-avatar-frame svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The dark filled control used for avatar download.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #20242a; border-radius: 0; background: #20242a; color: #f5f2e9; font: 700 12px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.84); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet outlined control for copy and shuffle actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #20242a; border-radius: 0; background: #f5f2e9; color: #20242a; font: 700 12px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #eeeae0; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Compact dark-ink links aligned along the desktop wordmark.
components.css: .ds-top-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; color: #484b4c; font: 500 12px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-top-nav a:hover { color: #20242a; } .ds-top-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Seed Input
components.description: A simple underlined field for a deterministic avatar seed.
components.css: .ds-seed-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #20242a; font: 500 9px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-seed-field input { padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #20242a; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #20242a; font: 500 12px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-seed-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #20242a; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Ikonym keeps a steady paper-toned developer interface around saturated geometric avatars. Each identifier chooses a tile architecture, orientation, and color permutation; the repeated cells touch edge-to-edge and fill the complete avatar. Motif families alternate at every horizontal and vertical neighbor.
keyCharacteristics: Bold navy, blue, cyan, pink, orange, yellow, mint, and cream palette.
Every avatar is a complete 3×3, 5×5, 7×7, 9×9, or 12×12 tiled mosaic.
The identifier determines motif layout, orientation, and color assignment while the interface remains fixed.

rules.name: The Seamless Tile Rule
rules.body: Every cell meets its neighbor exactly; no blank gutters, borders, or mismatched edges interrupt the tessellation.

dos: Do keep the interface theme stable while varying tile archetype and color assignment by seed.
Do fill the complete avatar square with flush tile cells.
Do change motif orientation and color rhythm while preserving the chosen tile grammar.
donts: Don't return to fluid washes and wave-line avatar patterns.
Don't leave paper gaps or borders between tile cells.
Don't mix unrelated tile archetypes inside one avatar.
Don't trace the reference sheet's exact arrangement or present generated motifs as a specific cultural tradition.
